author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The RP Nova is a watershed moment for 4:3 handheld gaming, where everything comes together nicely. I’m excited to share all the ways I’ve been enjoying this device.

Buy one here: https://tinyurl.com/RPNovaRGC
Impressions video: https://youtu.be/usQQ42egzus

Mentioned in the video:
OdinTools (saturation adjustment): https://github.com/langerhans/OdinTools/releases
Color tool: https://leaf.game/nova-colorways/
Comfort Grips: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4534284509/retroid-pocket-nova-comfort-grip-case
Switch 4:3 mods: https://aar.fayaz.one/ and https://github.com/pacoa-kdbg/Switch-Emulator-Ultrawide-FPS-Mods
Does it 4:3 Steam list: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43078746-Does-it-4-3/
Retroid DIY shop: https://tinyurl.com/Retroid-DIY
Retroid Dual-Screen: https://tinyurl.com/RetroidScreen

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
